## Specification

### Component: ConfirmMorph

A destructive button that morphs, in place, into an inline confirmation ("Delete 3 files? Cancel / Delete"), then a spinner, then a result with Undo. One box changes width, colour and content; nothing opens elsewhere.

#### Anatomy
```
<div class="ui-confirm [ui-confirm-lg]" data-phase="idle|confirm|pending|done|error" tabindex="-1">
  <span class="ui-confirm-layer ui-confirm-leaving" inert aria-hidden>previous phase</span>   (mid-morph only)
  <span class="ui-confirm-layer ui-confirm-current" data-enter>
    idle:    <button class="ui-confirm-trigger">icon + label</button>
    confirm: <span class="ui-confirm-row" role="group">question · Cancel (ghost) · Delete (destructive)</span>
    pending: <span class="ui-confirm-row ui-confirm-status">spinner · pendingLabel</span>
    done:    <span class="ui-confirm-row">check · resultLabel · Undo (ghost, if onUndo)</span>
    error:   <span class="ui-confirm-row">cross · errorLabel · Cancel · Retry</span>
  </span>
  <span class="ui-confirm-live" role="status" aria-live="polite">announcement</span>
</div>
```
Inner buttons are `Button` with size `xs` (box `md`, 36px) or `md` (box `lg`, 44px): box border 1px + 3px padding + inner height = box height; inner radius `--radius-sm`.

#### Props
- `label`, `question` (`ReactNode`), `icon`.
- `onConfirm: () => unknown | Promise<unknown>` — a rejection shows the error phase. `onUndo?` adds Undo to the result.
- `undoWindow` — ms the result stays before returning to idle, default **6000** (1600 with no `onUndo`; 0 keeps it).
- Copy: `confirmLabel` ("Delete"), `cancelLabel` ("Cancel"), `pendingLabel` ("Deleting…"), `resultLabel` ("Deleted"), `errorLabel` ("Couldn’t delete"), `undoLabel` ("Undo"), `retryLabel` ("Retry").
- `phase` / `defaultPhase` / `onPhaseChange` (controlled or uncontrolled, default `idle`), `size` `'md' | 'lg'`, `disabled`, plus `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` and ref.

#### Behaviour
- Click the trigger → `confirm`; Cancel / Esc → `idle`; Delete → `pending` → `done` (or `error`); Undo → `onUndo()` → `idle`; Retry runs `onConfirm` again.
- Surface per phase (semantic tokens only): idle `--ui-destructive` / `--ui-destructive-foreground`; confirm and done `--ui-surface-raised` + `--ui-border-strong` + `--ui-foreground`; pending `--ui-surface-muted` + `--ui-border` + `--ui-muted-foreground`; error `--ui-surface-raised` + `--ui-destructive` border + `--ui-destructive-text`. Check = `--ui-success-text`.
- Text 14px / 500 (15px in `lg`). Box radius `--radius-md` (`--radius-lg` in `lg`), `overflow: hidden`.
- **Focus**: only moves when focus was already inside. confirm → Cancel (safe default); pending → the box itself (`tabindex=-1`); done → Undo if present, else the box; error → Retry; back to idle → the trigger. Esc (confirm / error) calls `preventDefault` + `stopPropagation` so a parent dialog is not closed.
- The leaving layer is `inert`, so duplicated controls cannot be focused.

#### Motion
- **Width**: `useMorphWidth` — Web Animations API from the on-screen width to the new natural width, `--ui-spring-morph`, 550ms, interruptible, never on first render.
- **Content**: entering layer `ui-action-label-in` 220ms `--ui-ease-out` (4px rise, 2px blur clears); leaving layer `ui-action-label-out` 160ms `--ui-ease-in`, absolutely positioned at the start edge.
- **Colour**: background, border and text transition 220ms `--ui-ease-standard`.
- Trigger press: `scale(.97)` on `--ui-spring-snappy`.
- **Reduced motion**: width and content swap instantly (1ms fade); colours still change.

#### Accessibility
- Real buttons throughout; the confirm row is `role="group"` labelled by the question when it is a string.
- A polite live region announces the question, pending label, result or error.

#### Acceptance checks
- Idle shows only the destructive button; clicking it shows "Delete 3 files?" with Cancel and Delete, Cancel focused.
- Esc returns to idle with focus on the trigger. Delete → spinner → "3 files deleted" with Undo; Undo returns to idle.
- A rejecting `onConfirm` shows the error with Retry.
- The box width differs between idle and confirm and settles within ~600ms.

### `ui/components/confirm-morph/confirm-morph.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, type HTMLAttributes, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { CheckGlyph, CrossGlyph, SpinnerGlyph } from '../../lib/glyphs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useCrossfade } from '../../hooks/use-crossfade';
import { useMorphWidth } from '../../hooks/use-morph-width';
import { Button } from '../button/button';

export type ConfirmMorphPhase = 'idle' | 'confirm' | 'pending' | 'done' | 'error';
export type ConfirmMorphSize = 'md' | 'lg';

export interface ConfirmMorphProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children' | 'onError'> {
  /** Label of the destructive button, e.g. "Delete 3 files". */
  label: ReactNode;
  /** Icon before the label. */
  icon?: ReactNode;
  /** The inline question, e.g. "Delete 3 files?". */
  question: ReactNode;
  /** Default "Delete". */
  confirmLabel?: ReactNode;
  /** Default "Cancel". */
  cancelLabel?: ReactNode;
  /** Shown while `onConfirm` runs. Default "Deleting…". */
  pendingLabel?: ReactNode;
  /** Shown after success, e.g. "3 files deleted". Default "Deleted". */
  resultLabel?: ReactNode;
  /** Shown when `onConfirm` rejects. Default "Couldn’t delete". */
  errorLabel?: ReactNode;
  /** Default "Undo". Only shown when `onUndo` is set. */
  undoLabel?: ReactNode;
  /** Default "Retry". */
  retryLabel?: ReactNode;
  /** Runs when the user confirms. May return a promise. */
  onConfirm: () => unknown | Promise<unknown>;
  /** Adds an Undo button to the result. */
  onUndo?: () => unknown | Promise<unknown>;
  /** Milliseconds the result (with Undo) stays before returning to idle. Default 6000; 0 keeps it. */
  undoWindow?: number;
  /** Controlled phase. */
  phase?: ConfirmMorphPhase;
  /** Initial phase when uncontrolled. Default `idle`. */
  defaultPhase?: ConfirmMorphPhase;
  onPhaseChange?: (phase: ConfirmMorphPhase) => void;
  /** Height: 36 / 44px. Default `md`. */
  size?: ConfirmMorphSize;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

const inert = (el: HTMLElement | null) => el?.setAttribute('inert', '');

/**
 * ConfirmMorph — a destructive button that turns, in place, into its own
 * confirmation ("Delete 3 files? Cancel / Delete"), then a spinner, then a
 * result with Undo. Nothing opens elsewhere: the same box changes width and
 * content. Esc cancels; focus follows the next sensible control.
 */
export const ConfirmMorph = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ConfirmMorphProps>(function ConfirmMorph(
  {
    label,
    icon,
    question,
    confirmLabel = 'Delete',
    cancelLabel = 'Cancel',
    pendingLabel = 'Deleting…',
    resultLabel = 'Deleted',
    errorLabel = 'Couldn’t delete',
    undoLabel = 'Undo',
    retryLabel = 'Retry',
    onConfirm,
    onUndo,
    undoWindow = 6000,
    phase: phaseProp,
    defaultPhase = 'idle',
    onPhaseChange,
    size = 'md',
    disabled,
    className,
    onKeyDown,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useControllableState<ConfirmMorphPhase>({
    value: phaseProp,
    defaultValue: defaultPhase,
    onChange: onPhaseChange,
  });
  const shellRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const composedRef = useComposedRefs(ref, shellRef);
  const wantFocus = useRef(false);
  const mounted = useRef(true);
  const innerSize = size === 'lg' ? 'md' : 'xs';

  useEffect(() => {
    mounted.current = true;
    return () => {
      mounted.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const ask = () => {
    wantFocus.current = true;
    setPhase('confirm');
  };
  const cancel = () => {
    wantFocus.current = true;
    setPhase('idle');
  };
  const confirm = async () => {
    wantFocus.current = true;
    setPhase('pending');
    try {
      await onConfirm();
      if (mounted.current) setPhase('done');
    } catch {
      if (mounted.current) setPhase('error');
    }
  };
  const undo = async () => {
    wantFocus.current = true;
    try {
      await onUndo?.();
    } catch {
      /* the result is dismissed either way */
    }
    if (mounted.current) setPhase('idle');
  };

  // The result goes away on its own
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'done') return;
    const ms = onUndo ? undoWindow : 1600;
    if (ms <= 0) return;
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setPhase('idle'), ms);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [phase, onUndo, undoWindow, setPhase]);

  // Focus follows the interaction: Cancel when asking, the trigger when done, Undo / Retry on a result
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!wantFocus.current) return;
    const shell = shellRef.current;
    if (!shell) return;
    const active = document.activeElement;
    if (active && active !== document.body && !shell.contains(active)) {
      wantFocus.current = false;
      return;
    }
    const target =
      shell.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.ui-confirm-current [data-confirm-focus="${phase}"]`) ??
      (phase === 'pending' || phase === 'done' ? shell : null);
    target?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    if (phase === 'idle') wantFocus.current = false;
  }, [phase]);

  const handleKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      onKeyDown?.(e);
      if (e.defaultPrevented || e.key !== 'Escape') return;
      if (phase === 'confirm' || phase === 'error') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        wantFocus.current = true;
        setPhase('idle');
      }
    },
    [onKeyDown, phase, setPhase],
  );

  let content: ReactNode;
  if (phase === 'confirm') {
    content = (
      <span className="ui-confirm-row" role="group" aria-label={typeof question === 'string' ? question : undefined}>
        <span className="ui-confirm-text">{question}</span>
        <Button size={innerSize} variant="ghost" data-confirm-focus="confirm" onClick={cancel}>
          {cancelLabel}
        </Button>
        <Button size={innerSize} variant="destructive" onClick={confirm}>
          {confirmLabel}
        </Button>
      </span>
    );
  } else if (phase === 'pending') {
    content = (
      <span className="ui-confirm-row ui-confirm-status">
        <SpinnerGlyph />
        <span className="ui-confirm-text">{pendingLabel}</span>
      </span>
    );
  } else if (phase === 'done') {
    content = (
      <span className={cn('ui-confirm-row', !onUndo && 'ui-confirm-status')}>
        <CheckGlyph className="ui-confirm-ok" />
        <span className="ui-confirm-text">{resultLabel}</span>
        {onUndo && (
          <Button size={innerSize} variant="ghost" data-confirm-focus="done" onClick={undo}>
            {undoLabel}
          </Button>
        )}
      </span>
    );
  } else if (phase === 'error') {
    content = (
      <span className="ui-confirm-row">
        <CrossGlyph className="ui-confirm-bad" />
        <span className="ui-confirm-text">{errorLabel}</span>
        <Button size={innerSize} variant="ghost" onClick={cancel}>
          {cancelLabel}
        </Button>
        <Button size={innerSize} variant="destructive" data-confirm-focus="error" onClick={confirm}>
          {retryLabel}
        </Button>
      </span>
    );
  } else {
    content = (
      <button type="button" className="ui-confirm-trigger" data-confirm-focus="idle" disabled={disabled} onClick={ask}>
        {icon}
        {label}
      </button>
    );
  }

  const { leaving, animate } = useCrossfade(phase, content);
  useMorphWidth(shellRef, phase);

  const announcement =
    phase === 'confirm' ? question : phase === 'pending' ? pendingLabel : phase === 'done' ? resultLabel : phase === 'error' ? errorLabel : null;

  return (
    <div
      {...props}
      ref={composedRef}
      tabIndex={-1}
      className={cn('ui-confirm', size !== 'md' && `ui-confirm-${size}`, className)}
      data-phase={phase}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
    >
      {leaving && (
        <span key={`out-${leaving.key}`} ref={inert} className="ui-confirm-layer ui-confirm-leaving" aria-hidden="true">
          {leaving.node}
        </span>
      )}
      <span key={phase} className="ui-confirm-layer ui-confirm-current" data-enter={animate || undefined}>
        {content}
      </span>
      <span className="ui-confirm-live" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
        {announcement}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-crossfade.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../lib/dom';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

interface Layer<K extends string> {
  key: K;
  node: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Keeps the previous layer alive for `duration` ms after `key` changes so CSS
 * can crossfade it out while the new layer fades in.
 *   const { leaving, animate } = useCrossfade(state, content);
 *   <span key={state} data-enter={animate || undefined}>{content}</span>
 *   {leaving && <span key={`out-${leaving.key}`} aria-hidden>{leaving.node}</span>}
 * `animate` is false until the first change, so nothing animates on mount.
 * Under `prefers-reduced-motion` no outgoing layer is kept.
 */
export function useCrossfade<K extends string>(key: K, node: ReactNode, duration = 160) {
  const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState<Layer<K> | null>(null);
  const last = useRef<Layer<K>>({ key, node });
  const changed = useRef(false);
  const timer = useRef(0);

  if (last.current.key !== key) changed.current = true;

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const prev = last.current;
    last.current = { key, node };
    if (prev.key === key || prefersReducedMotion()) return;
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
    setLeaving(prev);
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setLeaving(null), duration + 40);
  });

  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), []);

  return { leaving, animate: changed.current };
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-morph-width.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../lib/dom';
import { animateSafe, readSpring, type SpringName } from '../lib/spring';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

/**
 * Springs an element's width to its new natural width whenever `key` changes
 * (a label swap, a state change). The element keeps `width: auto`; this
 * measures the old and new widths and animates between them with the Web
 * Animations API, so content never snaps. Interruptible: a change mid-flight
 * starts from the width currently on screen. Skipped for the first render
 * and under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
 *
 * The element should clip its overflow (`overflow: hidden`) so the outgoing
 * content does not spill while the width is still catching up.
 */
export function useMorphWidth(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, key: unknown, spring: SpringName = 'morph') {
  const previous = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const animation = useRef<Animation | null>(null);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    // Width on screen right now (mid-flight animations included)
    const visual = el.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    const running = animation.current && animation.current.playState === 'running';
    animation.current?.cancel();
    animation.current = null;
    const natural = el.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    const from = running ? visual : previous.current;
    previous.current = natural;
    if (from === null || Math.abs(from - natural) < 1 || prefersReducedMotion()) return;
    const { easing, duration } = readSpring(spring, el);
    const anim = animateSafe(el, [{ width: `${from}px` }, { width: `${natural}px` }], { duration, easing });
    if (!anim) return;
    animation.current = anim;
    anim.onfinish = () => {
      if (animation.current === anim) animation.current = null;
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [ref, key, spring]);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      animation.current?.cancel();
    },
    [],
  );
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

### `ui/lib/spring.ts`

```ts
import { prefersReducedMotion } from './dom';

export type SpringName = 'snappy' | 'smooth' | 'morph';

export interface SpringTiming {
  /** A CSS `linear(...)` curve (or a cubic-bezier fallback). */
  easing: string;
  /** Milliseconds. */
  duration: number;
}

const FALLBACK: SpringTiming = { easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)', duration: 420 };

/**
 * Read a spring preset (`--ui-spring-<name>` + `-duration`) from CSS so that
 * Web Animations API animations use exactly the same curve as CSS transitions.
 * WAAPI cannot resolve `var()` in `easing`, hence the computed-style read.
 */
export function readSpring(name: SpringName, el?: Element | null): SpringTiming {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return FALLBACK;
  const style = getComputedStyle(el ?? document.documentElement);
  const easing = style.getPropertyValue(`--ui-spring-${name}`).trim();
  const raw = style.getPropertyValue(`--ui-spring-${name}-duration`).trim();
  let duration = parseFloat(raw);
  if (raw.endsWith('ms')) duration = parseFloat(raw);
  else if (raw.endsWith('s')) duration = parseFloat(raw) * 1000;
  return {
    easing: easing || FALLBACK.easing,
    duration: Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0 ? duration : FALLBACK.duration,
  };
}

/**
 * `el.animate()` that never throws: a browser without `linear()` support
 * rejects the easing, so retry with a plain ease-out. Returns null when
 * the Web Animations API is missing.
 */
export function animateSafe(
  el: Element,
  keyframes: Keyframe[] | PropertyIndexedKeyframes,
  options: KeyframeAnimationOptions,
): Animation | null {
  if (typeof el.animate !== 'function') return null;
  try {
    return el.animate(keyframes, options);
  } catch {
    try {
      return el.animate(keyframes, { ...options, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)' });
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
}

export { prefersReducedMotion };
```

### `ui/styles/components/confirm-morph.css`

```css
/* Confirm morph -------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-confirm [ui-confirm-lg]" data-phase="idle|confirm|pending|done|error">
     <span class="ui-confirm-layer ui-confirm-leaving" inert aria-hidden>…</span>
     <span class="ui-confirm-layer ui-confirm-current">
       idle:    <button class="ui-confirm-trigger">icon + label</button>
       confirm: <span class="ui-confirm-row">question + Cancel + Delete</span>
       pending: <span class="ui-confirm-row ui-confirm-status">spinner + label</span>
       done:    <span class="ui-confirm-row">check + label + Undo</span>
       error:   <span class="ui-confirm-row">cross + label + Cancel + Retry</span>
     </span>
     <span class="ui-confirm-live" role="status">
   </div>
   One box: its width springs (JS, useMorphWidth) and its colours transition per phase.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-confirm {
    --ui-confirm-h: 2.25rem;
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    height: var(--ui-confirm-h);
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: var(--ui-destructive);
    color: var(--ui-destructive-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 500;
    outline: none;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      border-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-confirm-lg { --ui-confirm-h: 2.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); font-size: var(--text-md); }

  /* Per-phase surface */
  .ui-confirm[data-phase="confirm"],
  .ui-confirm[data-phase="done"] {
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    border-color: var(--ui-border-strong);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
  }
  .ui-confirm[data-phase="pending"] {
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-muted);
    border-color: var(--ui-border);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  }
  .ui-confirm[data-phase="error"] {
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    border-color: var(--ui-destructive);
    color: var(--ui-destructive-text);
  }
  .ui-confirm[data-phase="idle"]:has(.ui-confirm-trigger:focus-visible) {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 35%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-confirm[data-phase="idle"]:has(.ui-confirm-trigger:disabled) { opacity: 0.5; }

  .ui-confirm-layer {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 100%;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ui-confirm-layer[data-enter] { animation: ui-action-label-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-confirm-leaving {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: ui-action-label-out var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both;
  }

  /* The destructive button the box starts as */
  .ui-confirm-trigger {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    height: 100%;
    padding-inline: 1rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-confirm-trigger:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.97); }
  .ui-confirm-trigger:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-confirm-trigger > svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-confirm[data-phase="idle"]:has(.ui-confirm-trigger:hover:not(:disabled)) {
      background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 88%, var(--ui-background));
    }
  }

  /* Rows: text, then the buttons tucked into the right edge (concentric radii) */
  .ui-confirm-row {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    height: 100%;
    padding-inline: 0.75rem 0.1875rem;
  }
  .ui-confirm-status { padding-inline: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-confirm-row > .ui-btn { flex-shrink: 0; }
  .ui-confirm-row > .ui-btn-xs { border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
  .ui-confirm-text { padding-inline-end: 0.25rem; }
  .ui-confirm-status .ui-confirm-text { padding-inline-end: 0; }
  .ui-confirm-ok { color: var(--ui-success-text); }
  .ui-confirm-bad { color: var(--ui-destructive-text); }

  .ui-confirm-live {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: -1px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
  }
}

/* Reduced motion: phases still swap and recolour; nothing lifts, blurs or springs */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ui-confirm-layer[data-enter] { animation: ui-fade-in 1ms both; }
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```


## Usage

**Delete files** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/confirm-morph/delete-files.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { ConfirmMorph } from '@/ui/components/confirm-morph';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

export default function ConfirmMorphDeleteFiles() {
  return (
    <ConfirmMorph
      icon={<Icon name="trash" />}
      label="Delete 3 files"
      question="Delete 3 files?"
      pendingLabel="Deleting…"
      resultLabel="3 files deleted"
      onConfirm={() => wait(1100)}
      onUndo={() => wait(300)}
    />
  );
}
```
